roverMission: NASA Mars Science Laboratory (MSL) Curiosity Rover (Gale Crater)

channels.label: Total Dose B (Silicon Detector)
channels.desc: Total absorbed ionizing radiation including cosmic background and rover MMRTG contribution.

channels.label: RTG-Corrected Dose B (Silicon)
channels.desc: Cosmic ray and solar particle surface dose with Curiosity's nuclear power generator (MMRTG) background subtracted.

channels.label: Total Dose E (Tissue-Equivalent Plastic)
channels.desc: Absorbed radiation dose through polymer plastic that mimics the atomic density of human muscle tissue.

mandatoryIntegrityRule: MSL RAD data was measured inside Gale Crater by Curiosity. It is NOT a measurement at the fictional Jezero habitat. Absorbed dose in µGy is NOT the same as biological dose equivalent in Sieverts (Sv) without radiation quality weighting factors.
